clause: Table 3: Accidental damage to your car
text: Accidental damage to your car by cover level. Essential: Market value; Plus: Market value; Premier: Market value; Fire & Theft: Not included; Third Party: Not included.
Fire and theft by cover level. Essential: Market value; Plus: Market value; Premier: Market value; Fire & Theft: Market value; Third Party: Not included.

Stolen keys by cover level. Essential: £250; Plus: £500; Premier: £750; Fire & Theft: Not included; Third Party: Not included.
Lost keys by cover level. Essential: Not included; Plus: Not included; Premier: £400; Fire & Theft: Not included; Third Party: Not included.
Misfuelling by cover level. Essential: Not included; Plus: Not included; Premier: Included; Fire & Theft: Not included; Third Party: Not included.
Courtesy car by cover level. Essential: Not included; Plus: Up to 21 days; Premier: Up to 35 days; Fire & Theft: Not included; Third Party: Not included.
Personal belongings by cover level. Essential: Not included; Plus: £150; Premier: £400; Fire & Theft: Not included; Third Party: Not included.
Driving other cars by cover level. Essential: Not included; Plus: Conditional; Premier: Conditional; Fire & Theft: Conditional; Third Party: Conditional.
Cover abroad (EU) by cover level. Essential: 60 days; Plus: 60 days; Premier: 60 days; Fire & Theft: 30 days; Third Party: 30 days.
